onboarding.title: Choose your language
onboarding.subtitle: You can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding.more_languages_body: You can also speak or type in these languages. The AI understands them and replies in them; screens stay in English.
onboarding.consent_subtitle: Here is what JanaVaani does with your information.

consent.store: We store your complaint, any photos you add, and the location you share, only to resolve your complaint. You can report anonymously.
consent.ai: AI translates your words, suggests the department and priority, and summarizes the case for officers. AI-made content is marked.
consent.humans: People make the decisions that matter: emergencies, critical priority, unclear routing and disputed closures.

onboarding.optional: Optional. You can change this later.
onboarding.synthetic_note: This is a demo: all complaints shown are synthetic.
onboarding.a11y_subtitle: Pick anything that helps. You can change these any time in Settings.
